classes.purpose: Prepare a new client matter or a new matter for an existing client for lawyer review
classes.content: Selected identity and contact material; client, assisted-party, counterparty and other relevant party names, aliases and identifiers; requested work, facts, jurisdiction and procedural posture; engagement scope, exclusions, authority and fee status; conflict-register search references and candidate matches; possible deadline triggers and source references; confidentiality restrictions; conditional AML applicability material; privacy and retention posture; missing items; original imported filenames (including aliases for identical bytes), evidence names, bytes and SHA-256 receipts; model provenance; proposed folder plan; lawyer review decisions and final package status. The workflow does not promise automatic anonymization, automatic conflict clearance, binding deadline calculation, engagement acceptance or local-only model processing.

classes.purpose: Reopen locally retained client matter inputs and finalized artifacts
classes.content: Returned local index path, counts and navigation status or error. Generated local HTML contains existing matter labels, dates, statuses and relative links to exact ledger files; it creates no document copies and makes no external requests.

classes.purpose: Reconnect an explicitly approved client archive in fresh sessions
classes.content: The last approved local archive root and root-specific confirmed identity aliases remain in an owner-private local profile, separately from session-owned configuration and active run selection. These profile files are not automatically sent to the model or copied into the archive. Returned archive locations, matching client IDs and safe directory labels can enter the invoking model context. Continuity requires the host to retain the local profile; temporary hosts provide no persistence guarantee.

classes.purpose: Prepare source-linked negotiating positions from a selected tracked Word document or selected earlier round
classes.content: Selected contract and proposed/deleted text, paragraph context, revision authors and dates, comments and anchors, party roles, instructions, exact quotations, model-authored grouping/effects, requested responses and selected earlier review. Local helpers inventory, validate and render retained files; they make no Mike or separate model API request. Generic legal-source queries use the product legal-question workflow. Host model and Word processing follow the selected account; no automatic anonymization or local-only model guarantee.

classes.purpose: Diagnose a handled Archive helper failure through the existing local host review
classes.content: Handled Archive, OS, value and SQLite exceptions are logged before the unchanged structured JSON error returns. The local traceback can enter the selected host model context when the host reviews the tool failure; it can contain dynamic paths or case values and is not automatically anonymized. Logging does not send the traceback to an external service. The shared helper change does not add an incident service or a separate model call to Lucia.

external_boundaries.destination: Current official legal, regulatory, bar and public-authority sources selected for the matter-opening question
external_boundaries.purpose: Verify current professional boundaries or a generic legal source needed to frame an intake issue
external_boundaries.content: Generic law, authority, provision, date, jurisdiction and topic queries plus public source URLs; no client identity, party identity, private facts, conflict-register content, documents, credentials, cookies or session material
controls: Use generic topic-level queries and keep client, party and matter identifiers out of public research.
Record the exact source URL, authority and retrieval date before using it as a source reference.
Keep credentials, cookies, tokens, one-time codes and private register content out of research requests.

external_boundaries.destination: The existing managed-runtime installer endpoints for uv, CPython 3.12 and the published shared Python dependency recipes
external_boundaries.purpose: Prepare or repair the shared CPython 3.12 environment before executing a local archive worker
external_boundaries.content: Runtime and package identifiers, published requirements and constraints, and ordinary connection metadata. The installer is invoked before the archive command; no client files, archive index, identities, receipt bytes or case content are sent to dependency endpoints.
external_boundaries.workflow_conditions: The archive MCP server invokes the product managed launcher. A ready shared runtime is reused; missing runtime dependencies may require network access under host permissions. Failed setup stops worker execution. Optional OCR remains separately approved.
controls: Use the existing shared CPython 3.12 runtime and declared recipes; do not install arbitrary packages from archive input. Host network denials stop setup rather than selecting an unsupported worker interpreter.

security_controls.control: Initialization rejects repository paths, uses owner-only permissions and atomic writes; evidence intake accepts only regular non-linked files, snapshots bytes without moving or renaming originals, and records size and SHA-256.

The validator checks exhaustive schema structure, reference closure, immutable evidence hashes, professional-gate completeness and receipt freshness while explicitly leaving conflict, deadline, applicability and engagement judgments to the lawyer.

Review decisions bind the exact intake and substantive review payload digests, require a named reviewer and explicit confirmation, and become stale when the intake changes. The local workbench restores only valid decisions for the current review and validates submitted page bindings before replacing a saved decision file.
The workflow proposes a folder plan but never moves, renames or deletes source files and never claims that a client, engagement, conflict result or deadline was accepted automatically.

AML applicability is represented as a separate professional assessment with applicable, not-applicable or uncertain status; the workflow does not infer applicability merely because a client or matter is new.

Durable Studio Archive finalization requires run-bound, hash-consistent model-data JSON and Markdown reports. The shared local helper validates supplied phase evidence and writes these artifacts without contacting a model or requesting a server attestation; it does not independently prove provider transmission or infer zero transmission from missing telemetry.

Studio Archive separates default configuration by host session identity, holds a process lock on configured state and rejects configuration changes during an operation. These controls do not anonymize case data or prove provider transmission.

Approved archive discovery is revalidated before a fresh isolated session adopts it; existing sessions stay pinned. Private identity aliases are root-specific and short cross-process transactions prevent lost updates. Unavailable or malformed profile state fails closed, and private profile storage must remain outside source archives.
